scenario.title: GitHub access, repository publication and issue sync
situations: No GitHub account or another Git provider
User later asks about issue mirroring or CI
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Can users distinguish all three choices without extra setup questions?
Does general GitHub/relay teaching have one public source, with private operations only linking to it?

lessons.title: Connecting GitHub is optional
lessons.when: GitHub step, access refusal or later integration request
lessons.need: Skip the integration when it is not wanted or available. Authorization and repository access need their own checks; skipped GitHub is not a failed readiness check. Recommend All repositories for the product App so future repositories need no settings visit; selected installations show their direct settings link in setup and status. Explain that all repositories grants access across the account and that user authorization does not change installation scope.
lessons.gap: Accepted correction: skipped GitHub makes the token check N/A. Audit exactly which later operations require GitHub and provide alternatives only where supported.
lessons.review: Repository-scope teaching observed in source and regression tests; GitHub documents all repositories selected when repository IDs are omitted. Optional-connection recipe still needs live proof.

lessons.title: Publishing a repository is a separate choice
lessons.when: New project creation or later publication
lessons.need: A prepared Git repository can stay local. Connecting a GitHub account does not mean every project must be published there.
lessons.gap: JOURNEYS 4–5 currently makes pushing to GitHub sound mandatory. That edge should be reviewed against the supported keep-local path.

lessons.title: Issue mirroring stays quietly off in the TUI
lessons.when: No TUI question; agent-led explanation only when relevant
lessons.need: GitHub issue synchronization is another independent setting. The interactive installer silently leaves it off; it can be changed later. In agent-led setup, explain the effect and ask before enabling issue sync.
lessons.gap: The saved plan still contains the older TUI question. This map applies the accepted conversation correction; stronger dedup work remains deliberately deferred.
